title: Herbal Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry with a hint of herbal flavor.

ingredients.name: Herbal Stir Fry Sauce
ingredients.notes: Make by mixing together 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon honey, 1 tablespoon olive oil, and 1 teaspoon dried herbs like thyme or rosemary.

instructions: Heat the Light Oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the Garlic and Ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the Bok Choy and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until it starts to wilt.
Add the Herbal Stir Fry Sauce and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the Crispy Noodles and stir-fry for another minute, until they are well coated with the sauce.
Season with Salt and Pepper to taste.
